```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

I am choosing option 2 for the homework and recreate the graph of homicide data.

## Clean the Data and get homicide counts for each month

```{r}
homicides <- read.csv("homicide-data.csv")

homicides <- homicides %>% mutate(city_name = paste(city, state, sep = ", ")) %>% 
  select(-lat, -lon, -city, -state) %>% 
  filter(city_name == "Baltimore, MD") %>% 
  mutate(reported_date = ymd(reported_date)) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(reported_date), month = month(reported_date, label = TRUE))

homicidecounts <- homicides %>% count(year, month, name = "row_count") %>% 
  mutate(date = paste(month, year, sep = " "))

homicidecounts$date <- my(homicidecounts$date)

homicidecounts$season <- ifelse(homicidecounts$month %in% c("Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"), "Winter", "Summer")
```

## Graph the data

```{r}
ggplot(homicidecounts, aes(x = date, y = row_count)) + 
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Winter" = "lightblue", "Summer" = "lightgray")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", span = 0.1, se = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-01"), 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "red", 
             linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Monthly homicides",
       x = "Date",
       fill = NULL) +
  ggtitle("Homicides in Baltimore, MD") +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```
